title: Senior DV Protocol Checklist
description: A mindset checklist for finding corner-case bugs in protocol implementations.

items.text: Did I test 0-delay handshakes (READY high before VALID)?
Did I test maximum backpressure (slave holds READY low for 1000+ cycles)?
Did I test single-cycle backpressure (READY toggling every other cycle)?
Does the master legally hold all DATA and control signals stable while stalled?
Did I test back-to-back bursts with no idle cycles between them?
Does the system maintain forward progress (no livelock/deadlock) under heavy contention?
Are error responses (like SLVERR) handled gracefully by the master?
